notes.title: Ann First Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h2]Happy First "Ann"iversary!![/h2]

Time sure flies by, it's been a full year since Ann was released and it was a great pleasure for me to see all the supports from the community for the past year. 

To commemorate this special occasion I am going to showcase more community highlights, discuss about hidden/secret game contents and some updates to play the game in other languages!

===============================================================

[h2]Game Contents & Secret Cutscenes[/h2]

To those who wants to 100% the game, or just replay the game to experience more contents, there's an achievement guide made by an awesome member of the community, you can view the guide here: 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2580167222]Click Here to view the Guide[/url]

There is also a secret/hidden cutscenes that aren't tied to the achievements. Not many people have discovered them so I am here to give you guys some hints on how to access them; 

Before the Bad Ending 3 (The New Resident of The School Ending), you are given some time to explore the "Endless" Computer room before the screen fades to black, don't waste any time and quickly navigate down the room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40092759/d229757320ac9b1e06d1daa5ef44f83701324382.png[/img]

You will encounter a peculiar "Object" that looks just like any other objects in that room but looks slightly different, you will know when you see it. Interact with it and it will trigger a cutscene. There are 3 of them with 3 different cutscenes, have fun finding them!

If you want more behind the scenes, or deleted endings / deleted contents-related stuff you can Purchase the DLC here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581630/Ann__Digital_Artbook__Extra_Contents/

===============================================================
[h2]Play Ann in other languages[/h2]

If you want to play Ann in your own language, the community has translated the game into many other languages! You can check out the full post here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1511270/discussions/0/3035978213214456528/

*Note* 
- They are fan translations so I can't endorse neither can I officiate the accuracy of the translations. 
- If you want to volunteer for translation, please contact me at discord or any of my social media @Rong Rong or Discord (Link is at the game's Steam Store page)

===============================================================

I still watch all new gameplay videos on Youtube and read all Steam reviews. Every feedback or criticism about the game is very valuable for me! So if you haven't done so, please give the game a review! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40092759/e8ce7aaf907dbf2399b5d89c493cc539bde2e66b.png[/img]

That's all for now. If there are more game news or updates in the future, it will be announced in a new post in the future. Thank you for playing and supporting the game!
See you next time!

- Jason H. (Rong Rong)

===============================================================

notes.title: Community Creations Highlights 1
notes.content:
When Ann was released last week I was really scared and nervous as it was my first attempt at releasing a fully-developed video game. I was scared that no one would play the game as the game is developed using RPG-Maker engine which doesn't really have many good reputation in today's gaming landscape. Many things came to my mind when I was about to push the "release" button. I just wanted to pay homage to the golden age of Horror RPG-Maker games in 2012.

Fast forward 1 week later and here we are. I watched almost all gameplay videos that I can find on Youtube & Twitch and it has been a blast. Thank you everyone for the positive response of the game and thank you for playing the game! Words can't describe how happy I was when watching all your reactions towards the spooky sections and the true ending of the game! I love you all!!

- Jason H. (Rong Rong)

====================================================================

That being said, I received some awesome fanarts from you guys and it made me really really really really happy! ːSaffronCryː ːSaffronCryː As I thought no one would actually go as far as to make fanarts for this game. But dang, yall mad lads actually made it, I have scoured the internet to find more but here are most artworks that I have found so far, enjoy!

notes.title: 31 August - Minor Update, Boss nerf & bug fixes.
notes.content:
- "Failure" boss nerfed.
- Fixed some weird pathing in the Sculpting Department.
- Fixed some minor grammar mistakes.
- Fixed the text at the illustration at ending 4.
- Adjusted the volume of the true ending credits scene.

(If you encounter new bugs after this update please report them to the "Discussion" tab at the game steam library)

===========================================

(The updates below may contain spoilers so stop reading now if you haven't completed the game)

- Fixed a weird audio glitch in the secret cutscene "Unknown Memories - Ivy"
